name: Muse Video.TV
tagline: AI video and image workflows with creative briefs and reference inputs.
description: Muse Video.TV provides browser-based video and image editors. Start with a written idea, choose an available model, attach references where supported and review the units before submitting a generation request. Muse Video and Muse Image support up to nine authorized PNG or JPEG references totaling 11 MiB. Prompt libraries and brief starters help prepare the input. Generation requires a signed-in account and paid monthly units; browsing and planning are free. The service works in desktop and mobile browsers and has no native app download.
